answer_2.quote: We report two complementary metrics, Correct-Unamb and Detect-Ambig. Correct-Unamb indicates accuracy on the unambiguous set, and Detect-Ambig measures detection of ambiguity in ambiguous sentences.

answer_4.quote: We use the AmbiCoref dataset and human experiment results ... compare model results with the human annotations by mapping both to the schema [A, A?, ?, B?, B].
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to choose which noun the pronoun refers to or mark it as ambiguous.
